Rille started playing quake back in 97.
First known as "Cojones" later as "NephenteS" and finally as "Rille" which is also his real name.
He started his first clan early on and called it "Kamel Utan Kondom" mostly for the shortname "KuK" which most ppl know means a mans best friend in swedish.
